dataset_spec.name: uci_support2
dataset_spec.description: UCI SUPPORT2 (Study to Understand Prognoses and Preferences for Outcomes and Risks of Treatments, 1989-1994, five US teaching hospitals): seriously ill hospitalised adults; class-stratified subsample of 1000 for the readout, whole table for XGBoost. 37 predictors measured on study day 3. Binary in-hospital death.
dataset_spec.setting: Seriously ill adult hospitalised in one of five US teaching hospitals and enrolled in the SUPPORT study with one of nine advanced disease categories. The observations were recorded on the third day after study entry: demographics, disease group, comorbidity count, physiology and laboratory values, SUPPORT and APACHE III scores, physician survival estimates, resuscitation orders and functional status.

text_values.ARF/MOSF w/Sepsis: Acute respiratory failure or multiple organ system failure with sepsis
text_values.MOSF w/Malig: Multiple organ system failure with malignancy

text_values.ARF/MOSF: Acute respiratory failure or multiple organ system failure
text_values.COPD/CHF/Cirrhosis: Chronic organ failure (COPD, heart failure or cirrhosis)

scoma.text_label: SUPPORT coma score on day 3 (Glasgow-based, model estimated)

avtisst.text_label: Average Therapeutic Intervention Scoring System (TISS) score, days 3-25
avtisst.scale_note: points; higher means more intensive treatment

aps.text_label: APACHE III acute physiology score on day 3

hday.text_label: Hospital day on which the patient entered the study

prg2m.text_label: Physician's estimate of the probability of surviving 2 months

prg6m.text_label: Physician's estimate of the probability of surviving 6 months

text_values.dnr before sadm: DNR order written before study admission
text_values.dnr after sadm: DNR order written after study admission

dnrday.text_label: Day of the DNR order relative to study entry
dnrday.scale_note: negative if written before study entry

meanbp.text_label: Mean arterial blood pressure on day 3

wblc.text_label: White blood cell count on day 3

adlp.text_label: Activities of daily living index reported by the patient

text_values.0: No activities of daily living impaired

adls.text_label: Activities of daily living index reported by a surrogate

text_values.0: No activities of daily living impaired

adlsc.text_label: Activities of daily living index, imputed and calibrated to surrogate report

hosp_death.question: Based on this day-3 record, did the patient die before discharge from this hospital stay?
